name: Harmony Shipman
source:
"I've figured it out. All of it."

Harmony is an unmatched problem solver. With exceptional foresight and prediction, she is able to accurately assess situations to determine every possibility and outcome. However, she is not all-knowing; she requires the necessary pieces before she can truly complete a puzzle.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sugarslip/serial-lover/]Kickstarter[/url]]
